TICKET
# All images on shop stop working due to missing rewrites

If your products do not have link rewrite and a name, all product images stop working and their URL looks like this: `http://example.com/33-home_default/.jpg`.

## Attendu
There should be a fallback if there is no rewrite.

## Étapes
>Edited by Khouloud

Steps to reproduce the issue 
Install Ps with English language & France country 

1. Create a product > upload an image & enable it
2. Don't click on the preview button & don't click on save again
3. Go to FO > Search this product & select french language 
4. See an error 
5. Same issue in the list page 

I attached a screen record

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/16067358/155131003-f649f167-149d-4c28-be8b-098e611cfe0b.mp4

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**UDPATE: I cannot reproduce it this way for a second time. :(**

1. Install Prestashop.
2. Add new language, enable it.
3. Go to front office and switch to this language.
4. See no images.
